rules.name: rrr-orm-qcx-types
rules.sql: SELECT derivative_type, product_code, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, MIN(contract_number) AS example_contract, MIN(maturity_date) AS first_maturity FROM dbsystemuat.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table_orm WHERE SUBSTRING_INDEX(contract_number, '_', 1) = 'QCX' GROUP BY derivative_type, product_code

SELECT derivative_type, product_code, COUNT(*) AS n_securities, MIN(security_id) AS example_security FROM dbsystemuat.cloned_security_info_table_orm WHERE security_id LIKE 'CR ADDUSD 2026%' OR security_id LIKE 'CR ADDUSD 2027%' GROUP BY derivative_type, product_code

SELECT derivative_type, product_code, COUNT(*) AS n_securities, MIN(security_id) AS example_security FROM opera_backup_04_10.cloned_security_info_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu AND (security_id LIKE 'CR ADDUSD 2026%' OR security_id LIKE 'CR ADDUSD 2027%') GROUP BY derivative_type, product_code

SELECT derivative_type, product_code, COUNT(*) AS n_securities, MIN(security_id) AS example_security, MIN(created_by) AS first_creator, MIN(created_timestamp) AS first_created FROM opera.cloned_security_info_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu AND (security_id LIKE 'CR ADDUSD 2026%' OR security_id LIKE 'CR ADDUSD 2027%') GROUP BY derivative_type, product_code
